```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

myData <- penguins
```

```{r}
# pages are managed by HEADER 1
# rows are managed by HEADER 2
```

# Page 1 - Graphs/Plots

## Row 1

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# removes warning

# mass by island
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = myData, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# removes warning

# bill length by island
# shortcut code
bill_length_by_island <- ggplot(myData, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_length_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# body mass by flipper length
##| title: Flipper Length by Mass
ggplot(myData, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# body mass by bill length
##| title: Bill Length by Mass
ggplot(myData, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

# Page 2 - Data table

This dataset describes 344 individual penguins and comes from the 'palmerpenguins' package. These three species of penguins live on three different islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

```{r}
myData <- myData |>
  select(-c(year))

knitr::kable(myData)
```
